copy.headline: Affidavit: Dallas mother ambushed on her birthday by brother-in-law, nephew
copy.caption:
What first raised fears of road rage was an alleged family ambush, police say. One relative is under arrest and another is accused.

Police say a Dallas mother of four, shot and killed while driving home from work on her birthday, was ambushed by two family members: her husband's brother and nephew. On Sunday, DPD announced the arrest of a suspect in the Nov. 15 shooting death of Stephanie Chavarria Gonzalez, 35, along 5500 CF Hawn Freeway in Dallas.

story.title: Affidavit: Dallas mother ambushed on her birthday by brother-in-law, nephew
story.summary: What first raised fears of road rage was an alleged family ambush, police say. One relative is under arrest and another is accused. Police say a Dallas mother of four, shot and killed while driving home from work on her birthday, was ambushed by two family members: her husband's brother and nephew. On Sunday, DPD announced the arrest of a suspect in the Nov. 15 shooting death of Stephanie Chavarria Gonzalez, 35, along 5500 CF Hawn Freeway in Dallas. Tragically, her final moments were captured on a 911 call, according to police. Police arrested Juan Antonio Gonzalez-Orduna on a murder charge. Orduna, 29, is listed as an undocumented migrant and is being held without bond. According to charging documents obtained by NBC 5, the alleged gunman is another man: Jose Antonio Samudio Gonzalez, the victim's nephew.
